Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — Springboard onboarding health: we've been seeing p99 tail latency spikes on generation (~320ms baseline -> ~650ms during morning surge). They’re on hosted API and UI times out for users. I want to propose a conservative performance play: canary an int8 quant variant behind a routing rule + add warm-up prefix caching. Thoughts?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Can you share token length distribution and any traces? Sometimes batching or KV-cache churn causes this; quant helps cost but not always seq-length heavy workloads.
Lee (Springboard): Copy — in prod we average ~180 tokens per prompt but have bursts with >1k tokens for multi-step workflows. Seeing timeouts reported by support at ~600ms p99.
Priya (Onboard PM): We should avoid any customer-visible regression. My suggestion: small canary (10% traffic) for non-critical endpoints, keep canonical model for high-precision flows (billing/agreements). Also schedule warm-up before biz hours.
Eli (Product): Can we gate by an evaluation set and auto-rollback if quality drops? Product metric: semantic accuracy delta > 1.5% should trigger revert. Do we already have a quick eval for Springboard?
Maria (CSM): I created a 200-prompt eval set with gold responses from their onboarding flows. Plan sketch: 1) Canary int8 variant (48h, 10%) 2) Traffic routing rule scoped to intake endpoints 3) Prefetch/warmup for morning spike 4) Monitor latency, cost, and QA metrics with auto-revert on eval threshold.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can draft the routing + quant profile. We have a vetted variant "redwood-llama-13b-int8-v1" that usually preserves parity. Also recommend prefix cache TTL=30s for repeated system prompt to reduce KV misses. Example route rule:```yaml
route_rule:
  match: header('x-customer-route') == 'springboard-intake'
  variant: redwood-llama-13b-int8-v1
  weight: 0.10
```
Maria (CSM): Nice. Can you estimate cost delta? Lee, will this change break any of your internal QA checks?
Lee (Springboard): :thumbsup: 10% sounds safe. Our QA checks are lightweight. Cost estimate would help us sign off.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: int8 yields ~30-40% per-token compute savings vs fp16 for this family. With prefix cache and less KV churn we might see ~40-50% improvement in tail cost for these routes. Exact depends on sequence mix.
Maria (CSM): I'll capture cost delta for their finance contact and include in the canary brief.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: springboard-int8-canary -> 2026-03-25T15:00Z, 10% traffic, monitor hooks enabled.
Priya (Onboard PM): I'll book a 30-min call with Springboard Wed 10am PT to walk through the rollback criteria and support plan.
Eli (Product): Please hook the eval runner to the canary; post eval results to the thread every 6 hours.
Maria (CSM): Thanks — SE to push routing + quant profile, Onboard PM to schedule call, I'll share the eval set and cost estimate. Follow-up thread after 48h canary with metrics.
Lee (Springboard): Appreciate the coordination. We'll standby for the call invite and monitor our dashboards.
Maria (CSM): Closing note: minimal user-facing change target; if anything spikes in error rate or semantic drift >1.5%, we revert immediately. Will post updates here. :rocket:
